content: [{"id":"njw-setup-head","type":"header","data":{"text":"Set it up","col":12}},{"id":"njw-setup-steps","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Open Njiwa Settings and paste the API key from your Njiwa console. Save, then press Test connection: it reads the saved key and lists the WhatsApp numbers this account really has. Then press Send test message, give it your own number, and read what comes back. That is the whole setup.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-setup-testkey","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Start with a key beginning sk_test_. Every message is checked and stored, and nothing reaches a real phone until you swap it for a key beginning sk_live_.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-settings","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa Settings","col":3}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-console","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa console","col":3}},{"id":"njw-shortcut-docs","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Njiwa docs","col":3}},{"id":"njw-spacer","type":"spacer","data":{"col":12}},{"id":"njw-send-head","type":"header","data":{"text":"Sending from your own code","col":12}},{"id":"njw-send-body","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Njiwa Settings carries ten ready-made moments to send on - orders, invoices, credit notes, payments and deliveries - and every one of them is off until you turn it on. Each has wording you can edit, and clearing that wording turns one message off on its own. For anything the ten do not cover, your own code sends it: one import and one call, from njiwa_frappe.api import send, which belongs in a background job whenever somebody is waiting for a screen.","col":12}},{"id":"njw-links","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The console at console.upeo.ai is where keys are made, numbers are linked, and every message already sent can be read back with its status and its failure reason. The docs at docs.njiwa.upeo.ai cover what a message can carry and give every error code a page of its own.","col":12}}]
